description.zh: 为用途角色指定模型并持久化：chat=日常对话/Agent 主模型，vision=涉及图片时用的多模态模型，compression=大上下文语义压缩模型，asr=语音转写后端（sensevoice 或 whisper，可带 whisper_size）。用户要求「用 X 模型做 Y」时使用。
description.en: Assign a model to a purpose role (persisted): chat = main conversation/agent model, vision = multimodal model for images, compression = large-context semantic compressor, asr = speech backend (sensevoice or whisper, optional whisper_size). Use when the user says "use model X for Y".

model.description: chat/vision/compression 填模型的显示名称；asr 填后端名 sensevoice 或 whisper
for chat/vision/compression: the model's display name; for asr: backend name sensevoice or whisper
